chain.name: Adobe RGB (1998)
chain.description:
Developed by Adobe Systems, Inc. in 1998. It was designed to encompass most of the colors achievable on CMYK color printers, but by using RGB primary colors on a device such as a computer display. The Adobe RGB (1998) improves upon the gamut of the sRGB color space, primarily in cyan-green hues
Encompasses roughly 50% of the visible colors specified by the Lab color space

meta.description: AdobeRGB 1998 identity — open in Photoshop, apply colour grade, reimport as LUT
